candidate_workaround: Split broad Git and filesystem status probes into bounded single-purpose commands and inspect the minimum exact state needed.
failure_signature: A combined file, Git status, head, and branch command timed out before returning any attributable output.
recurrence_guard: Do not begin recovery with a whole-worktree status call when exact file, head, and branch probes suffice.
rollback: Credit no state from the timed-out wrapper and rerun only bounded read-only probes.
scope_boundary: Read-only owner-lane recovery only; no mutation or broader claim credit.
title: Decompose overbroad worktree probes after timeout
trigger_preconditions: A combined status wrapper exceeds its bounded execution window without attributable output.
